captions.linkedin:
"Can you keep it to one page?" is still one of the most common resume asks, and getting there by hand usually means 9-point font and no margins.

QuickFit CV's Fit to 1 page does it in one click, in a fixed order:
• First it tightens spacing and text size
• Then it merges lines within a role, using only your own words
• It never adds anything new, and the result stays readable

Free to try: https://quickfitcv.com

#resume #jobsearch #careers
